raw:
Agent Name: Verification_Expert  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: Verification_Expert made an error during the verification process by accepting the data from Realtor.com as confirmed without ensuring the consistency and reliability of the information across the other sources, Zillow, Redfin, and Trulia. Although Realtor.com reported the highest selling price at $5,200,000, the other sources listed prices lower than this. Verification should have involved a deeper investigation into the discrepancy between sources rather than assuming Realtor.com to be decisive without comprehensive cross-verification, given the conflicting reports from other sites.
